XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Loss of stroke on acceleration, uneven idle speed

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Body computer

  • Fault: Closing the driver’s side window activates the hazard warning lights. Conversely, activating the hazard warning lights whilst the driver’s side window is open causes the window on that side to close automatically.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty contacts on the body computer connectors

• Action: Check the condition of the contacts on the body computer connectors and, if necessary, restore them

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The body computer is located beneath the steering wheel on the left-hand side. In this particular case, the contacts on the body computer’s connectors were found to be oxidised, and following their restoration, the fault was permanently resolved.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.7 h.
    Problems with this component are quite common on this model.
